content.text:
The migrated file is at `out/module.ts` and it type-checks with `tsc --strict`. I didn't run it against the original's outputs: lodash isn't installed, so I only checked by reading the call shapes.

- **`publicFields`:** uses `pick` from `es-toolkit`, with the same arguments as before.
- **`totalAge`:** uses `sumBy` from `es-toolkit`. The string shorthand `'age'` becomes `(r) => r.age`, a one-line adapter, because the main `es-toolkit` build only takes a function. This still returns `0` for an empty array.
- **`toLookup`:** `es-toolkit` has no `fromPairs` in its main build, so I import `fromPairs` from `es-toolkit/compat`. Later duplicate names overwrite earlier ones, as in lodash.

`npm run size -- out/module.ts` prints 311 bytes (min+gzip) with 101 bytes of own code. I couldn't measure the original with that command, because it imports lodash and the bundle fails, so I don't have the baseline for the own-code allowance.

I also tried building `toLookup` from main-build `unzip` and `zipObject` instead. That was 308 bytes total but 123 bytes of own code, so I kept the compat `fromPairs`. The scratch files I used for that are deleted, so `out/` contains only `module.ts`.
